technique_name: Describe the impact of industrialization on a country’s economy.
description: Industrialization has a positive effect on a country’s economy by creating jobs, increasing productivity levels, creating economic growth, increasing wages and incomes, and increasing exports. It also creates new markets and industries, brings in foreign investment, and creates taxes. By increasing productivity, industrialization can improve standards of living and create a more sophisticated and diverse economy that produces a wide range of products, services, and technologies.
